purpose: Use existing consumer evidence to decide necessary CR fidelity before heavy execution

required.source_history: q(t), zero/nonzero prehistory, source age and time coordinate
required.source_spectrum: spectral shape and its time dependence; normalization and energy domain
required.bath: density, temperature, ionization state, background/time map and their variation
required.observable: heating rate/cumulative heating or a named downstream observable
required.error_budget: absolute/relative budget with denominator; signal and CR contribution if applicable

available_recorded_scope.kernel: fixed finite model from pinned cache

CR_on_missing_data_behavior: TYPED_UNAVAILABLE; never replace missing CR-on with zero
next_action: Resolve current existing consumer files before asking user; controlled diagnostic may proceed with explicit scope
